title: Mechanistic Insights into HP1alpha CSD Oligomerization and the Role of PxVxL Motif-Containing Proteins.
authors: Kumar, Amarjeet; Sakuraba, Shun; Gaurav, Nitika; Selvam, Karthik; Kutateladze, Tatiana G; Kono, Hidetoshi
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究HP1alpha CSD寡聚化及KAP1 PxVxL基序调控机制，属蛋白质-蛋白质互作而非TF-DNA体系，但模拟方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA界面动态研究。
abstract: HP1 oligomerization is crucial for chromatin compaction, transcriptional regulation, and heterochromatin maintenance. The dynamic transition between HP1 monomeric, dimeric, and higher-order oligomeric states modulates the chromatin structure and phase separation. By controlling the HP1 oligomerization dynamics, chromatin-associated processes involving HP1 can be regulated. In this study, we employed molecular dynamics simulations to investigate HP1alpha chromo shadow domain (CSD) oligomerization, focusing on how PxVxL motif-containing partner KAP1 and flanking residues (FRs) modulate dimerization at the alpha-helix and beta-sheet interfaces. Our findings reveal that in the monomeric state the C- and N-tails remain frequently in contact with the beta-sheet face, restricting its accessibility and favoring dimerization at the alpha-helix face. Dimerization at the alpha-helix face creates the PxVxL motif binding cavity and suppresses intramonomeric C-tail-beta-sheet interactions. However, intermonomeric C-tail-beta-sheet interactions are enhanced, thereby opening the beta-sheet face partially. Following the KAP1 binding, the C-tail-beta-sheet interactions are suppressed and N-tail flexibility is promoted, making the beta-sheet face available for dimerization. Dimerization at the beta-sheet face involves interactions between the beta-sheet face residues from two CSD units, of which the hydrophobic interactions mediated by L139 and L150 and polar interactions mediated by R115 are critical. KAP1 FRs interact with the beta-sheet residues laterally. Overall, our comparative analysis of KAP1-bound and unbound CSD dimers elucidates the molecular mechanism of HP1 oligomerization and highlights how KAP1 binding drives structural rearrangements that modulate HP1's function as an adaptable molecular scaffold in heterochromatin formation.
abstract_zh: HP1寡聚化对于染色质压缩、转录调控和异染色质维持至关重要。HP1单体、二聚体和更高阶寡聚状态之间的动态转变调节染色质结构和相分离（phase separation）。通过控制HP1寡聚化动力学，涉及HP1的染色质相关过程可被调控。在本研究中，我们采用分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟来探究HP1alpha染色质阴影结构域（chromo shadow domain, CSD）的寡聚化，重点关注含PxVxL基序的伙伴蛋白KAP1及侧翼残基（flanking residues, FRs）如何调节α-螺旋和β-折叠界面的二聚化。我们的发现揭示，在单体状态下，C-端和N-端尾部频繁与β-折叠面接触，限制其可及性并有利于在α-螺旋面进行二聚化。α-螺旋面的二聚化形成PxVxL基序结合腔，并抑制单体内部C-尾-β-折叠相互作用。然而，单体间C-尾-β-折叠相互作用增强，从而部分开放β-折叠面。在KAP1结合后，C-尾-β-折叠相互作用被抑制，N-尾灵活性增强，使β-折叠面可用于二聚化。β-折叠面的二聚化涉及两个CSD单元中β-折叠面残基之间的相互作用，其中由L139和L150介导的疏水相互作用及由R115介导的极性相互作用至关重要。KAP1的FRs与β-折叠残基侧向相互作用。总体而言，我们对KAP1结合和未结合CSD二聚体的比较分析阐明了HP1寡聚化的分子机制，并强调了KAP1结合如何驱动结构重排，从而调节HP1作为异染色质形成中适应性分子支架的功能。
